```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(ezrsurvey)
library(ggplot2)
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE,
                      fig.width = 10, fig.height = 5.5, dpi = 150)

# Replace with your own data, e.g.:
# d <- read_folder("data/") |> select_prefix(c("demo_", "ratings_"),
#                                            keep = "respondent_id")
d <- consumer_survey
```

# Summary

## Net Promoter Score

```{r}
plot_nps_gauge(calc_nps(d, nps_value)$nps)
```

## Importance / Performance

```{r}
ipm_model(d, nps_value, "ratings_") |> plot_ipm()
```

# Audience

## Gender

```{r}
calc_percentage(d, demo_gender, sort = "desc") |> plot_bars()
```

## Education

```{r}
calc_percentage(d, demo_edu, sort = "asc") |> plot_bars(flip = TRUE)
```

## Motivations

```{r}
calc_percentage_multi(d, "motivations_", id = respondent_id, sort = "asc") |>
  plot_bars(label = option, flip = TRUE)
```

# Appendix

## Data precision

```{r}
diagnose(d, demo_gender, dplyr::starts_with("ratings_"))
```
